subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's persisted `announceLastRun` marker, `killed` reconciliation state, and always-tool-free subagent completion announce handoff as the merge path for Telegram restart recovery?
rationale: The code appears correct and well-proven, but it changes stored session lifecycle semantics and a security-relevant tool boundary, which automation should not silently accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept after lint rerun
options.body: Rerun or waive the failed hosted `check-lint`, then merge with the current `announceLastRun`, `killed`, and tool-free announce behavior.

options.title: Request a different session state
options.body: Ask the author to change the non-running state or marker semantics if `killed` is not the desired persisted outcome for aborted delivery-only announce turns.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want a generic inter-session delivery recovery model instead of an announce-specific marker.

recommendation.title: Accept after lint rerun
recommendation.body: Rerun or waive the failed hosted `check-lint`, then merge with the current `announceLastRun`, `killed`, and tool-free announce behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest available recent-history signal across the restart lifecycle and Codex internal-turn surfaces involved in the maintainer choice.
